entities.name: František Plass
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: František Plass was a football player and manager. He made 164 appearances in the Czechoslovak First League, scoring 16 goals, as well as two appearances in the European Cup Winners' Cup. He played for Czechoslovakia, representing his country 11 times between 1968 and 1972. Plass later worked as a manager, taking charge of numerous teams between 1981 and 1998. He led Dukla Prague during the 1992–93 Czechoslovak First League, but was replaced after 16 games by Jiří Fryš, with the club going on to finish the season in 14th place.
